test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of manufacturing activity?

options.text: Mutual fund product made by combing debt and equity funds

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mutual fund product made by combing debt and equity funds.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Mutual fund product made by combing debt and equity funds** is NOT an example of** manufacturing activity.**
 
• A **"mutual fund product" **is an investment vehicle provided by **asset management companies (AMCs) **or mutual fund companies.
 
• These funds gather money from numerous investors and then invest it in a diversified portfolio of securities, which may include stocks, bonds, money market instruments, or a mix of these assets.
 
• The allocation of these investments is determined by the fund's investment objective. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manufacturing activity** encompasses the **process of converting raw materials** into finished goods through various stages of **processing, assembly, and packaging**.
 
• This involves the use of specialized machinery, equipment, and skilled labor to efficiently transform raw materials into the desired products.
 
• Quality control measures are implemented throughout the production process to ensure that the finished products meet specified standards and regulatory requirements.
 
• Effective supply chain management is vital in manufacturing, as it involves coordinating activities such as raw material sourcing, production scheduling, and distribution logistics to ensure smooth operations and timely delivery of goods.
 
• Manufacturing plays a pivotal role in driving economic growth, creating employment opportunities, and contributing to the development of industrial infrastructure.
